missionPremise: Per the flood-fragments CP2 damage census and this card's own two addenda: PR #74's never-clobber guard (owned-rail allowlist + a never-downgrade-to-unaccounted SQL guard in UPSERT_CELLS_BATCH_SQL) had to land and deploy, then every county-rail pair wiped by the earlier clobber had to be healed by re-running its owning job and verifying against that rail's own original close, and the phantom run 122cd0b2 had to be resolved rather than left running forever.
completionPredicate: PR #74 merged, deployed, and sanity-checked live (an owned rail gets a fresh vintage on re-run, a rail this job does not own does not). Every wiped county-rail pair from the damage census re-run and verified against its owning close: flood for 48021/48209/48309/48453/48491, wells+specialDistricts for 48491, valueHistory for 48491, zoningDistrict store-wide. 48055 (Caldwell) correctly excluded throughout as a pre-existing gap, not damage. S6-COLLISION's Williamson dollar rails confirmed untouched by the entire heal pass. The phantom run 122cd0b2 is resolved (status='killed'). Ready to close.
scopeBasis: This card's own note restricts coordination with the S6 lane to closes only, so no direct action was taken on S6-owned rows -- only a read-verify that the heal pass never touched them. The two additional phantom rows discovered mid-heal (9ef1b6d4, 28823aa1) and the reap tick's own status-string precondition bug were explicitly out of THIS card's scope (no Cloud Run execution evidence existed for a manual reap terminate, and the precondition bug is a cross-cutting Factory concern) -- both were carried as a leave_behind into a dedicated follow-on card (FACTORY-REAPER-PHANTOMS, closed separately this session) rather than worked here.
